notes:
Template. Copy to P01.json etc. and edit. Validate with:
  python -m data_io.study_config P00_example --block 1

'interface' selects what the participant SEES (rgb | pointcloud | both | none) and drives the VR launch mode. 'control' selects how they DRIVE the arm during an intervention (telekinesis | motion_controller | sim_mc | factr) and drives the launcher's FACTR_ACTIVE / MC_ACTIVE / MC_SIM flags. 'control' may be omitted; it defaults to telekinesis, which is what configs written before it existed were run with.

blocks.notes: no 'control' key: resolves to the telekinesis default
FACTR leader arm drives the simulated robot during interventions
